title: The Curious Giraffe
description: A curious giraffe leans into the frame with a playful half-smile, its velvety ossicones and backlit ears glowing in warm late-afternoon sun. Golden cumulus clouds drift across a deep ocean-blue sky, and every whisker, eyelash and patch of fur is rendered in crisp ultra-realistic detail.

title: The Velvet Folds
description: Plush velvet rolls across the screen in soft layered waves, fading from deep violet through ocean blue to glowing teal. Thin ribbons of ivory silk catch the light between the folds, so every fiber and shadow feels rich and real enough to touch.

title: The Glass Tide
description: Sculpted layers of frosted sea glass roll across the screen like a frozen tide, shifting from glowing teal through ocean blue to deep violet. Tiny air bubbles and soft caustic light make every curve feel cool, smooth and real enough to touch.

title: The Glass Puzzle Cube
description: A floating puzzle cube of frosted glass and brushed titanium tiles glows from within in teal, ocean blue and violet, caught mid-turn above a dark mirror-like floor. Soft blue haze, drifting bokeh and colorful reflections give this ultra-realistic phone wallpaper a calm, futuristic glow.

title: The Sapphire Globe
description: An antique globe of deep sapphire enamel with raised gold-leaf continents floats in a brass meridian ring, glowing softly against a calm ocean-blue gradient. A quiet, luxurious desktop wallpaper with an open left side that keeps your icons clean and readable.

title: The Neon Halo
description: A perfect ring of hand-blown glass neon tubing glows from icy cyan to deep violet and magenta above a wet black stone floor. Blue-violet haze drifts through the dark room while the ring's reflection shimmers on the polished ground.

title: The Empty Stage
description: A worn electric guitar leans on a vintage amp beside a chrome microphone, lit by a single warm Edison bulb against an old brick wall, while cold blue light from a rain-streaked window spills across the wet floor. A moody 4K desktop wallpaper with wide dark space in the middle for your icons.

title: Ember Lake at Dusk
description: Jagged snow-capped peaks burn ember red and orange in the last light, mirrored perfectly in a glassy alpine lake. A weathered wooden dock with a glowing brass lantern reaches into the calm water beneath a teal sky.

title: Rails to the Last Light
description: Weathered steel rails and cracked timber sleepers run straight toward a lone tree glowing against a thin amber sunset. Above, a calm navy-to-teal twilight sky leaves plenty of quiet space for your lock screen clock.

title: Cosmic Neural Bloom
description: Glowing threads of cyan, violet and amber light burst from a bright core and branch out like neurons across a deep starfield, woven through drifting nebula clouds. A vivid 4K desktop wallpaper full of cosmic energy and fine detail.

title: The Midnight Sconce
description: A weathered brass wall sconce glows warm amber on a rain-damp, midnight-blue brick wall, with tiny moths drifting in its light. An ultra-realistic, skeuomorphic 4K desktop wallpaper with calm, dark navy space on the left for your icons.

title: The Frozen Rose
description: A deep crimson rose sealed inside a crystal-clear block of ice, its petals dusted with frost feathers and tiny trapped bubbles. Cold blue light and drifting mist glow around the melting ice on dark wet slate.

title: The Ember Hourglass
description: An antique brass and walnut hourglass stands on dark slate, with glowing embers instead of sand trickling into a smoldering heap. Warm firelight and drifting smoke fill a moody 4K desktop wallpaper with a calm, dark left side for your icons.

title: The Obsidian Skull
description: A polished black obsidian skull rests on wet dark slate, its deep cracks glowing molten crimson on one side and electric blue on the other as smoke drifts upward. An ultra-realistic, skeuomorphic 4K desktop wallpaper with calm, misty dark space on the left for your icons.

title: Galaxy in the Geode
description: A cracked black geode rests on wet dark stone, its glowing amethyst crystals opening onto a swirling purple galaxy deep inside. An ultra-realistic, skeuomorphic phone wallpaper with misty black space at the top for your clock.

title: The Captured Singularity
description: A tiny black hole spins inside an antique brass orrery sealed under a hand-blown glass dome, its amber accretion ring glowing on a dark leather desk beside a candle and an old compass. An ultra-realistic, skeuomorphic 4K desktop wallpaper with calm, dark space on the left for your icons.

title: The Figure Behind the Glass
description: A faceless hooded figure presses both hands against the inside of your screen, his palms glowing cold blue through fogged, scratched glass. A dark, cinematic phone wallpaper in steel grey and midnight blue, with misty space at the top for your clock.

title: Neon Aurora Lock Screen
description: A glowing blue and violet aurora sweeps over dark hills and a still lake, framed by neon gradient outlines that sit perfectly around the clock and lock-screen widgets. Made for iPhone 12, 13 and 14 (1170×2532), and pairs with the Neon Frames Home Screen.

title: Neon Frames Home Screen
description: A deep navy home screen with glowing yellow-to-violet neon outlines framing every widget, app row and the dock. Made for iPhone 12, 13 and 14 (1170×2532), and pairs with the Neon Aurora Lock Screen.

title: Dark Library Shelf
description: A weathered dark wooden bookcase filled with old leather-bound books, softly lit against deep shadow. A moody, vintage dark academia phone wallpaper.

title: Manhattan Under Clouds
description: A sweeping aerial view of the Manhattan skyline, with the Empire State Building rising beneath dramatic purple storm clouds. A cinematic city phone wallpaper.

title: Bokeh Orbs
description: Glowing orange and blue bokeh orbs drift across a deep navy background, sprinkled with tiny embers. A dreamy abstract phone wallpaper.

title: Ocean Blue Gradient
description: A soft, smooth gradient flowing from deep teal to sky blue and lavender. A clean, minimal phone wallpaper.

title: The Lone Tree
description: A solitary tree stands in a green meadow under a clear blue sky, with a warm sunset glow on the horizon and two tiny figures walking below. A calm, minimal landscape phone wallpaper.

title: Red Balloon Over the Lake
description: A glowing red hot-air balloon floats above a still, misty lake, its reflection shimmering on dark water beneath a grey sky. A moody, cinematic phone wallpaper.

title: Layered Dunes
description: Soft layered waves of teal, cream, orange and deep red flow beneath a misty gradient sky. A warm, minimal abstract phone wallpaper.

title: Midnight Glow Frame
description: A deep navy gradient with a softly glowing neon-rimmed frame at the bottom. A sleek, minimal dark phone wallpaper.

title: Waves Below the Dark
description: Colorful abstract waves of blue, cream, orange and red rise from the bottom of a pure black screen. A bold, minimal AMOLED phone wallpaper.

title: Retro Rainbow Curves
description: Nested retro curves in navy, teal, cream, orange and red stack into a bold 70s-inspired design. A vibrant, minimal phone wallpaper.

title: Flowing Paper Ribbons
description: Layered paper-like ribbons in peach, orange, red, teal and sage curve across a dark charcoal background. A modern abstract phone wallpaper.

title: Raindrops on Glass
description: Crystal-clear raindrops scattered across a cool grey glass surface. A calm, minimal phone wallpaper.

title: Beacon of the Violet Night
description: A red-and-white lighthouse stands on a dark rocky cliff, its warm beam cutting through the mist as a giant glowing moon rises in a neon violet and magenta sky above crashing turquoise waves. A vivid, dreamy phone wallpaper.

title: The Light Left On
description: A lone man in a dark coat walks along a rain-soaked path toward a small wooden house, its porch light glowing warm against the deep blue night sky. A quiet, cinematic and moody phone wallpaper.

title: The Watcher at Dusk
description: A cloaked swordsman sits on a rocky cliff above a misty river valley, watching the sun set behind snowy peaks as a castle and an old stone bridge glow in the last light. A moody dark fantasy phone wallpaper.

title: Moonlit Citadel
description: A lone knight in a torn cloak stands on a cliff edge, sword in hand, facing a gothic citadel lit by embers beneath a giant full moon and stormy skies. A dramatic black-and-white dark fantasy wallpaper.

title: Where the Moon Waits
description: A woman in a flowing gown stands at the edge of a cliff as the wind lifts her cloak, a dark castle tower rising before a huge glowing moon in a cold blue night. A dreamy gothic phone wallpaper.

title: Aurora Over the Frozen Lake
description: Green and violet northern lights swirl above jagged snowy peaks, reflected in a cracked frozen lake glowing in the dark. A stunning night sky phone wallpaper.

title: Burning Eclipse – Desktop
description: A cloaked wanderer faces a burning black eclipse over a wasteland of dark rock and glowing embers, framed by heavy storm clouds. A 4K dark fantasy desktop wallpaper.

title: Burning Eclipse
description: A lone cloaked wanderer stands in a scorched valley beneath a black sun ringed with fire, the sky burning red and orange between dark storm clouds. A dramatic dark fantasy phone wallpaper.

title: Tree of Two Worlds – Blue & Gold
description: The same lone tree stands between icy blue and warm golden-orange halves, drawn in fine flowing light strands. A vibrant artistic phone wallpaper.

title: Tree of Two Worlds – Blue & Green
description: A bare tree branches into a split sky of electric blue and vivid green, every surface woven from fine glowing threads. A bold, artistic phone wallpaper.

title: Eclipse Volcano III
description: A quieter take on the Eclipse Volcano collection: a single ember-red eruption, soft black clouds and a silver river under a dark eclipse.

title: Eclipse Volcano II
description: Glowing lava veins split a layered paper volcano as black smoke rises toward a ringed eclipse and flying birds. Part of the Eclipse Volcano collection.

title: Eclipse Volcano I
description: A papercut-style volcano erupts beneath a black eclipse, lava running down its slopes into a dark river winding through pine forests. A dark, minimal AMOLED wallpaper.

title: Struck by Lightning
description: A bolt of lightning splits a lone tree in an open meadow, setting it glowing in fiery orange under a heavy grey storm sky. A dramatic 4K nature desktop wallpaper.

title: The Unfinished Game
description: The Grim Reaper sits alone at a worn wooden table in front of a cracked concrete wall, moving a piece in an unfinished game of chess. The chair across from him is empty. A 4K black-and-white desktop wallpaper with an old film look.

title: Rain on the Leaf
description: A deep green leaf covered in raindrops rests on a dark, wet stone surface glinting with blue light. A calm, dark nature wallpaper that looks great on OLED screens.

title: Compass and Candlelight
description: An antique brass compass rests on a weathered old map inscribed with the words "To Live is To Die", lit by the warm glow of an oil lantern, with rope, a leather journal and a spyglass around it. A dark, adventurous still life.

title: Waiting by the Clock
description: A lone man leans against an old iron street clock on a rainy seaside promenade, a seagull perched on top and a lighthouse fading into the fog. A quiet, moody black-and-white wallpaper.

title: The Last Stand – Misty Mountain
description: A dark fantasy scene: knights with torches and banners face a horde of horned gothic creatures at the foot of a misty, snow-capped mountain crowned by a fortress. Dramatic, cinematic and moody.

title: Minimal Mountains – Night
description: A calm night over layered blue mountains, with a full moon and a sky full of stars. Dark tones keep your lock screen clock easy to read.

title: Minimal Mountains – Sunset
description: The sun sinks behind warm pink and purple ridges as the sky fades from violet to gold. Part of the Minimal Mountains collection.

title: Minimal Mountains – Mist
description: Soft sage and grey peaks disappearing into morning fog under a pale sun. A light, quiet wallpaper from the Minimal Mountains collection.
